div.div:
Where the packets went
• LEAF-3 as the VTEP: never sent
• LEAF-3 as a router: outer packet split into 1514 + 84 bytes (the outer DF bit is clear), the NX-OS VTEP never reassembles it
Fix: MTU ≥ host MTU + 50 on every underlay link, both ends, and test it with ping -M do -s 1472

div.div:
Result: a one-way failure
• inside Cumulus: still works (wildcard import)
• NX-OS: the routes are in BGP but none reach the L2RIB; Cumulus to NX-OS pings 100% loss
• Cumulus still learns NX-OS hosts, so half the tables look right
Fix: in a multi-vendor eBGP fabric, set route targets explicitly and identically on every leaf
